name: fortune-web
description: Fortune Forged Wheels — Shopify theme development repo for fortuneforgedwheels.com

scripts.theme:list: bash scripts/with-env.sh shopify theme list --path theme
scripts.theme:pull: bash scripts/with-env.sh shopify theme pull --path theme --theme 188606447891 --force
scripts.theme:pull:live: bash scripts/with-env.sh shopify theme pull --path theme --theme 188606447891 --force
scripts.theme:dev: bash scripts/with-env.sh shopify theme dev --path theme --theme 188606447891
scripts.theme:push:templates: node scripts/sync-homepage-live.mjs && bash scripts/with-env.sh shopify theme push --path theme --theme 188606447891 --only 'templates/index.json' --only templates/index.live.json --allow-live
scripts.theme:check: bash scripts/with-env.sh shopify theme check --path theme
scripts.theme:info: bash scripts/with-env.sh shopify theme info --path theme
